read_boundaries: Opening definitions and interpretation, printed pp.1-3; unit action discussion at Section4; Proposition4.7, Lemma4.8, Corollaries4.9-4.10, and Section4.1 equations4.13-4.15, printed pp.26-28. Not a full audit of the paper or its TFT constructions.
use: Established diagonal unit actions and explicit inverses are prior art. The manuscript supplies its own elementary coordinate elimination proof and fixes its operator signs and carriers. No novelty claim or unproved reliance on the full bicategory is made.
